# TASK-167 — specification

## Scope

Fewer clicks to approve: a reviewer can review every section that needs it and has its required answers, and approve the baseline, in one action ("Review all and approve"). It is revision-guarded and audited, and it creates the tasks like any approval.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] `reviewAll` on baseline approval reviews every section that needs it and has its required answers, then approves.
- [x] It checks readiness on the would-be-reviewed specification first, so a refused approval writes nothing.
- [x] The one-click button appears only when reviews are all that is left.

## Verification

- tests/minimal-spec.test.ts
- readiness.test.tsx
- e2e/minimal-spec.spec.ts

## Notes

`reviewAll` in `api/review.ts`, checked on the would-be-reviewed specification first so a refused approval writes nothing.
